title: Kirby Problem 4.7
exact_target: Does one product stabilization make every homeomorphic closed oriented four-manifold pair diffeomorphic, or is there at least a universal finite number of stabilizations? Ask the corresponding questions for twisted-sphere-bundle stabilization as well.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2883 (KP-4.7). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 4.7, p. 196 and following remarks; original author version.
